rationale: Station-days whose settled daily high was published before the local day could produce it, by an ingest path that is now retired. Every entry was verified three ways: the recorded value is at least 3C below the maximum in the day's own complete observation record; the truth row's publication instant precedes the local afternoon; and its lineage carries only a handful of observations against 25-48 in the archive. They are excluded rather than corrected because AMSC is retired_history_only under the charter and their canonical facts were never written -- appending a projection revision with no canonical source would fabricate provenance to fix a number, which is the worse of the two errors. The rows stay exactly as they are and remain readable as history; consumers skip them.
detection_method: latest revision per station-day joined to archive observations over the settlement window; flag when archive_max - truth >= 3.0C
